title: Workers stay signed in and start clean
summary: Login rotation is fixed with a dedicated worker token, Claude and Codex worker startup is repaired, and false finished and merged states are closed.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: Claude stops logging you out. Workers use a dedicated inference-only token instead of a copy of your login, so a worker refreshing its token no longer signs you out.
Before you upgrade, stop any running workers. A worker already running when 0.1.738 starts cannot be signaled by the new build and has to be stopped by hand.
After you upgrade, run npm run worker:login once from a source checkout, or Claude workers fail closed with a worker-token error. The installed app cannot run this step yet.
Claude workers start signed in. The sandbox is built after the worker config directory exists.
Codex workers start again. The sandbox grants the exact read of the repo's own .codex/config.toml; neighboring reads and all config writes stay denied.
Fewer false finished and merged states. Failed and stopped turns report their real outcome, and review state derives from the lane outcome or the merge commit.
The Codex orchestrator default moves to the newest flagship Codex model. Workers keep the current default, and hosts without the new model fall back automatically.
Not fixed in this ship: workers still run under your macOS user and can read operator-scope environment state a same-user process can reach. Per-worker isolation is next.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Retirement of an already-deleted managed worktree completes in one sweep instead of refusing forever; one install logged about 2,400 refusals per start.
Merge preview admits packet-bound workers instead of rejecting their own preview request.
A stale review turn is abandoned when a new one starts or the packet closes.
A same-head lane with no work can still be marked merged; tracked for the next ship.

sections.title: Features
items: The voice agent can call tools from attached external MCP servers.
Interactive task artifacts with a return channel.
